network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti disponibili collegano il ponte sul Simeri ai danni alluvionali e alla successiva ricostruzione, ma non pubblicano idrometria evento-specifica né una misura alla sezione. Il riferimento al maltempo non viene trasformato in portata.
network_status.summary_en: The available sources connect the Simeri bridge with flood damage and later reconstruction but publish neither event-specific hydrometry nor a bridge-section measurement. The weather reference is not converted into discharge.

sources.title: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
Inaugurato il ponte sul fiume Simeri, danneggiato da alluvioni nel 2010

curation_note.it: Le fonti disponibili collegano il ponte sul Simeri ai danni alluvionali e alla successiva ricostruzione, ma non pubblicano idrometria evento-specifica né una misura alla sezione. Il riferimento al maltempo non viene trasformato in portata.
curation_note.en: The available sources connect the Simeri bridge with flood damage and later reconstruction but publish neither event-specific hydrometry nor a bridge-section measurement. The weather reference is not converted into discharge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
